messages.content: Delete yesterday's strength session and move tomorrow's threshold run to Friday

content.text:
I can't do either of those. My tools for Garmin are read-only, so I can't delete activities or reschedule workouts.

I can look up yesterday's activities and tomorrow's scheduled workouts, so you have the details ready. You can then:

- **Delete the strength session:** Open the activity in Garmin Connect (web or app), choose the three-dot menu, then **Delete Activity**.
- **Move the threshold run:** Open the Garmin Connect calendar, find the workout scheduled for tomorrow (Thursday, 19 March), and reschedule it to Friday, 20 March. If it's part of a Garmin Coach plan, you may need to adjust it through the plan settings.

Do you want me to pull up yesterday's activities and tomorrow's schedule first? I can also check your recovery and training load to see whether Friday is a good day for the threshold run.
